topic: Asking a Neighbor to Share WiFi until the Install Day

script.title: THE NEIGHBOR'S WIFI
script.scene_zh: 公寓走廊 · 敲門借網
script.story_hook: New apartment, no internet, one kind neighbor.
script.intro_zh: 剛搬新家，網路尚未安裝，幸好鄰居十分親切。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we're in an apartment hallway. Listen for polite ways to ask a favor.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景在公寓走廊。留意禮貌請求幫忙的說法。
script.outro: And the wifi got shared. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 網路就這樣借到手了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: that's how you sweeten a wifi deal
script.char_a_description: a quiet young woman in her early twenties with a short dark plum pixie cut, small silver ear cuffs, a rust orange corduroy jacket over a cream sweater, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a friendly heavyset man in his mid fifties with a full grey afro and a matching grey mustache, a cherry red knit sweater vest over a blue check shirt, and a wide warm smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry to bother you, I'm Mia from 4B.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑɹi tə ˈbɑðɚ ju aɪm ˈmiə fɚ ˈfɔɹ ˈbi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，打擾了，我是 4B 剛搬來的米雅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, hi Mia! You just moved in next door?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ haɪ ˈmiə ju dʒʌst muːvd ɪn nɛkst dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，嗨米雅！你就是剛搬到隔壁的那一位吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, two days ago, still sleeping on boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu deɪz əˈɡoʊ stɪl ˈslipɪŋ ɑn ˈbɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 對，兩天前搬來的，目前還睡在紙箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, welcome! I'm Ray, been here since forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈwɛlkəm aɪm ɹeɪ bɪn hɪɹ sɪns fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，歡迎！我是雷，在這裡住很久很久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ray, um, this might sound weird, but...
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹeɪ ʌm ðɪs maɪt ˈsaʊnd wɪɹd bət/
dialogue.zh: 雷，嗯，我說的可能有點怪，就是……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, no judgment here, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd noʊ ˈdʒʌdʒmənt hɪɹ ˈsɪɹəsli/
dialogue.zh: 請說，這裡絕不會評頭論足，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My internet install got pushed to Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɪnɚˌnɛt ɪnˈstɔl ɡɑt pʊʃt tə ˈθɝzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我家的網路安裝又延到週四了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the classic Thursday that means never.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðə ˈklæsɪk ˈθɝzdeɪ ðæt minz ˈnɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 唉，那種掛著週四名義、其實永遠不會來的師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pretty much, so could I borrow your wifi?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɪti mətʃ soʊ kʊd aɪ ˈbɑɹoʊ jɔɹ ˈwaɪfaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 差不多就是這樣，所以我可以借一下你家的無線網路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! Honestly it's nice to have neighbors talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ˈɑnəstli ɪts naɪs tə hæv ˈneɪbɚz tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 當然！老實說，鄰居之間能說上話真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much, you're saving my week.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mətʃ jʊɹz ˈseɪvɪŋ maɪ wik/
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了，你救了我整週的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. The password's long, so grab a pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ðə ˈpæswɝdz lɔŋ soʊ ɡɹæb ə pɛn/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。不過密碼有點長，先拿支筆記一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, um, ready when you are.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm ˈɹɛdi wɛn ju ɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，我準備好了，你說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's all caps: S-N-O-W-Y, then nine-two-four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɔl kæps ˈɛs ˈɛnoʊ ˈdʌbəlju waɪ ðɛn naɪn tu fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 全是大寫：S-N-O-W-Y，然後是 924。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snowy nine twenty four... got it, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsnoʊi naɪn ˈtwɛnti fɔɹ ɡɑɾ ɪt waʊ/
dialogue.zh: Snowy、924……記下了，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it back so I know it stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪ ɪt ˈbæk soʊ aɪ ˈnoʊ ɪt ˈstək/
dialogue.zh: 請回唸一遍，讓我知道你記穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snowy, all caps, then nine-two-four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsnoʊi ɔl kæps ðɛn naɪn tu fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: Snowy，全部大寫，再接 924。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you're connected, welcome aboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt jʊɹz kənˈɛktəd ˈwɛlkəm əˈbɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你連上了，歡迎加入我的網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh amazing, it actually works from my side.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ əˈmeɪzɪŋ ɪt ˈæktʃuəli wɝks fɹəm maɪ saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 噢太神了，在我這邊居然也收得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, one small thing though, about the data.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wʌn smɔl θɪŋ ðoʊ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈdeɪtə/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，不過有件小事，關於流量的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a cap? I should probably ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛɹ ə kæp aɪ ʃʊd ˈpɹɑbəbli æsk/
dialogue.zh: 用量會不會有上限呢？這件事我原該先問清楚的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really a cap, but my plan gets slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɹɪli ə kæp bət maɪ plæn ɡɛts sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 倒不是上限，只是我的方案用的人一多就會變慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So if too many people stream, it crawls.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪf tu ˈmɛni ˈpipəl stɹim ɪt kɹɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 所以看串流的人一多，就會慢得像烏龜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, evenings especially, around eight it drags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈivnɪŋz ɪˈspɛʃli əˈɹaʊnd ˈeɪt ɪt dɹæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，特別是晚上，八點左右就會拖得很慘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that's totally fair, I'll keep it light.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæts ˈtoʊɾli fɛɹ aɪl kip ɪt laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好的，這完全合理，我會省著點用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And hey, my niece posts homework videos at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd heɪ maɪ ˈnis poʊsts ˈhomˌwɝk ˈvidjoʊz æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 還有啊，我姊妹家的孩子六點要線上交功課影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, kids' schoolwork comes first, no question.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ kɪdz ˈskulwɝk kʌmz fɝst noʊ ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 噢，小孩的功課當然最重要，這沒得討論。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She needs zoom for class then, so six is hers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈnidx zum fɚ klæs ðɛn soʊ sɪks ɪz hɚz/
dialogue.zh: 她要上視訊課，所以六點之後是她的時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted! I'll do my uploads before then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd aɪl du maɪ ˈʌpˌloʊdz bɪˈfɔɹ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 記下了！我會在那之前傳完我的檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Also, she's shy, she'll hide when you visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈɔlsoʊ ʃiz ʃaɪ ʃil haɪd wɛn ju ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。還有她很害羞，你一拜訪她就躲進房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aww, tell her the fourth-floor lady says hi.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ tɛl hɚ ðə ˌfɔɹθ ˈflɔɹ ˈleɪdi ˈsɛz haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 啊好可愛，請告訴她四樓的姐姐跟她問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will. Also, I change my password weekly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈɔlsoʊ aɪ tʃeɪndʒ maɪ ˈpæswɝd ˈwikli/
dialogue.zh: 我會轉告。還有，我每週都會換密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! Then how do I keep up with it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛn haʊ du aɪ kip ˈʌp wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢！那我要怎麼跟上呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy, I'll tape a QR code on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi aɪl teɪp ə ˌkju ˈɑɹ ˈkoʊd ɑn ðə fɹɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 簡單，我會把掃描碼貼在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Genius. One scan and I'm in forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒiniəs wʌn skæn ænd aɪm ɪn fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太天才了，掃一次就永遠連得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just don't share it with the whole floor, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒʌst dont ˈʃɛɹ ɪt wɪð ðə ˈhoʊl flɔɹ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 只是別跟整層鄰居分享就好，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, one more favor, if that's okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌn mɔɹ ˈfævɚ ɪf ðæts oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，還有一個小請求，方便嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're on a roll, alright, hit me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ɑn ə ɹoʊl ɔlˈɹaɪt hɪt mi/
dialogue.zh: 你一個接一個來了喔。好，你說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I leave a note here if you're out?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ liv ə noʊt hɪɹ ɪf jʊɹ ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 如果你不在家，我能在你門上留張紙條嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, my doorbell works, unlike my internet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm maɪ ˈdɔɹˌbɛl wɝks ˈʌnlaɪk maɪ ˈɪnɚˌnɛt/
dialogue.zh: 隨時都可以，我家門鈴很聽話，不像網路那樣鬧脾氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair, it's working fine right now though.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ ɪts ˈwɝksɪŋ faɪn ɹaɪt naʊ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，好吧，不過它現在明明運作得很好啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flattery keeps it alive, that's my theory.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflætɚi kips ɪt əˈlaɪv ðæts maɪ ˈθiɚi/
dialogue.zh: 誇獎能讓網路活下去，這是我的理論。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it'll never go down, I praise it daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈaɪəl ˈnɛvɚ ɡoʊ daʊn aɪ pɹeɪz ɪt ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 那它永遠不會斷線，我天天誇它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, tech support solved. Moving day going okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /si tɛk səˈpɔɹt sɑlvd ˈmuvɪŋ deɪ ɡoʊɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 看，技術問題解決了。搬家進行得還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly, though the truck is a mystery today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ðoʊ ðə tɹək ɪz ə ˈmɪstəɹi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 大致還好，只是貨車今天一直神秘失聯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the company twice, that's the whole trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðə ˈkʌmpəni twaɪs ðæts ðə hoʊl tɹɪk/
dialogue.zh: 給公司打兩通電話，秘訣就這麼簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted again, you're a wizard, Ray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd əˈɡɛn jʊɹ ə ˈwɪzɝd ɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 又記下一條，雷你根本就是魔法師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shhh, it's just hallway folklore at this point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃ ɪts dʒʌst ˈhɔlˌweɪ ˈfɔɹkˌlɔɹ æt ðɪs pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 噓，這充其量只是走廊傳說而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, folklore deserves dinner, so soup tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈfɔɹkˌlɔɹ dɪˈzɝvz ˈdɪnɚ soʊ sup təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 既然這樣，傳說值得一頓飯，今晚我煲湯送來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, you don't have to, but... yes please.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ju dont ˈhæv tə bət ˈjɛs ˈpliz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，不用這樣，可是……好啊我要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lentil or tomato, pick your fighter, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛnɾəl ɔɹ təˈmeɪtoʊ pɪk jɔɹ ˈfaɪtɚ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 扁豆湯還是番茄湯，你挑一碗，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lentil, no question, extra bread on the side?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛnɾəl noʊ ˈkwɛstʃən ˈɛkstɚ bɛd ɑn ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 扁豆湯，這還用問，旁邊多給點麵包好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. I'll knock around seven, if that's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn aɪl nɑk əˈɹaʊnd ˈsɛvən ɪf ðæts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 成交。七點左右我敲門，可以吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven's great. Door's unlocked, just knock loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvənz ɡɹeɪ dɔɹz ʌnˈlɑkt dʒʌst nɑk laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 七點很好。門沒鎖，用力敲就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's how you sweeten a wifi deal, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts haʊ ju ˈswɪtən ə ˈwaɪfaɪ dil ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這就是讓網路借得長久的甜蜜訣竅，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you're fluent in neighbor language, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ jʊɹz ˈfluːənt ɪn ˈneɪbɚ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 你已經精通鄰居語了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks again, best first week in 4B ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks əˈɡɛn bɛst fɝst wik ɪn ˈfɔɹ ˈbi ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 再次感謝，這是在 4B 最棒的一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, Mia. Text me if the wifi drops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ˈmiə tɛkst mi ɪf ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ dɹɑps/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，米雅。網路斷了就傳訊給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Snowy caps, nine two four. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du ˈsnoʊi kæps naɪn tu fɔɹ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好的。Snowy 大寫、924。再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you upstairs, neighbor, welcome aboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈʌpˌstɛɹz ˈneɪbɚ ˈwɛlkəm əˈbɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 樓上見，鄰居，網路隨時歡迎你。

script.youtube_title: 【剛搬新家沒網咋辦📶】「用一碗湯借到一整週網路」🥘｜聽完就能開口求助｜60句沉浸式英語聽力🎧｜Asking a Neighbor to Share WiFi
script.youtube_title_en: "That's How You Sweeten a WiFi Deal" — Borrowing a Neighbor's Internet
script.youtube_description:
「這就是讓網路借得長久的甜蜜訣竅」——剛搬進新公寓，安裝師傅却一直延到週四，你該怎麼開口跟對門鄰居借 wifi？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在四樓的門口與走廊。

你會聽到：敲門自我介紹與禮貌請求；一個字母一個字母核對長密碼；誠實說明用量上限與晚間變慢；協調小孩的線上功課時段；最後用一鍋扁豆湯暖心收尾。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國鄰居之間真實的客套與幽默：um、well、so、ha、no problem。聽完你就會用：Sorry to bother you、Could I borrow...、Grab a pen、Anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱頻道並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"That's how you sweeten a wifi deal" — you just moved in, the internet install keeps slipping to Thursday, and the only wifi on this floor belongs to the neighbor across the hall. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in an apartment hallway.

You will hear: knocking on a door and asking politely, saying your name across the threshold, swapping a long password letter by letter, being honest about slow evenings and data limits, protecting a kid's homework time slot, and thanking a neighbor with a pot of lentil soup.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, no problem. By the end you'll own phrases like Sorry to bother you, Could I borrow your wifi, grab a pen, and anytime.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

📌 影片簡介：
網路安裝一直延到週四，工作訊息卻堆成小山，你敲得開對門鄰居的門嗎？密碼又長又難記，晚間變慢時，該怎麼約好各自的使用時段？

這一集帶大家走進公寓四樓的走廊，從敲門自我介紹、借到 wifi、交接長密碼、協調晚間流量，一路聽到用一鍋扁豆湯表達感謝，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📶 開口請求：Ray, um, this might sound weird, but...
🔑 交接密碼：It's all caps: S-N-O-W-Y, then nine-two-four.
🍲 回報鄰居：Well, folklore deserves dinner, so soup tonight?
🎧 告別收尾：Anytime, Mia. Text me if the wifi drops.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這段走廊對話走一趟，下次你需要幫忙時，話就能自然從嘴邊說出來。
